title: Vintage Harkerware 'A Home In The Wilderness'  6.25" Plate Gold Trim Currier
descriptionText: The product is a vintage Harkerware collector plate with gold trim, featuring a mid 20th-century design called 'A Home In The Wilderness'. Made of porcelain and shaped like a round plate, it measures 6.25 inches in diameter. This decorative piece was produced in the United States during the 1950s using pottery techniques, reflecting American culture and style of that era. Perfect for all occasions, this collector plate would make a unique and nostalgic addition to any collection.
